resolved_findings.trigger: Pause transport.run_bounded after Processes.run has checked stop but before the process is registered; call cancel once, then resume process creation.
resolved_findings.observed: The child started after cancellation and remained active until a second cancellation. A single cancellation can therefore miss a later registered SSH/rsync child and wait for its long original timeout.
resolved_findings.expected: Synchronize cancellation with registration or make later registration immediately terminate/reap the child; retain prompt process-group cleanup on one cancellation.

resolved_findings.trigger: Swap the banks parent directory only while Path.open acquires the file, restore the original directory before the read, and leave the bad canonical file metadata unchanged.
resolved_findings.observed: The helper hashes a different good inode, then sees unchanged pre/post path stats for the bad canonical inode and reports already_complete=true.
resolved_findings.expected: Compare fstat of the opened descriptor with the pre-open identity and check both descriptor/path stability after reading; apply corresponding descriptor checks to chunk reads and assembly publication.

resolved_findings.trigger: Cancel a child after it signals readiness and installs a SIGTERM-ignoring handler.
resolved_findings.observed: With SIGTERM-only cancellation the child remained active and the future incomplete after 0.3 seconds; manual SIGKILL was needed for the review fixture.
resolved_findings.resolution: The revised cancellation path immediately sends SIGKILL to its owned process groups, including late registrations, and original transport cleanup proves quiescence.

verified_invariants: Four exact frozen estimator bank destinations; whole-bank SHA-256, ordered chunk hashes and byte counts, descriptor/path identity, durable atomic publication and source mtime preservation.

Fixed lease identity, owned SSH marker, STOP, immutable setup/work deadlines, setup reserve, bounded 8-stream subprocesses and single-cancel process-group cleanup including late registration and TERM-ignoring descendants.
